Advertisement for Chemist
Tuesday, 31 July 2018
5522 Hits
Secretary, Kasturba Health Society invites applications on plain paper along with complete bio-data, certified photocopies of academic and experience certificates with names of two referees for the post of Chemist which must reach the Secretary, Kasturba Health Society, PO. Sevagram, Dist. Wardha - 442 102 latest by 11.08.2018.
Required Qualification and Experience: Must be M.Sc. in Chemistry/Biochemistry or A.I.C. in Analytical Forensic Chemistry with at least five years’ experience as Chemist working in Medical College / Laboratory for detection of poisons & narcotic drugs.
(Age below 38 years and Pay Scale Rs.9300-34800 + Grade Pay Rs.4400/- + other allowances as admissible under KHS rules)
Note: Age and experience can be relaxed for exceptional and deserving candidate.
Swachhata Pakhwada April 2024
